fact: Sunday Standard reports First Capital Bank Botswana has launched a cross-border payments platform that lets customers receive money from across the SADC region in real time.
system: First Capital Bank cross-border payments platform

fact: The TCIB scheme operated by PayInc is live into Botswana through First Capital Bank Botswana, which can now receive money instantly from South Africa via SendHome and from Zimbabwe via ZB Bank, per TechAfrica News.
Botswana is now a live corridor of TCIB, the cross-border scheme PayInc operates as SADC Regional Settlement Operator for the SADC region, per TechAfrica News.
